message.content:
In the key of **A** the blues scale is built from the A minor pentatonic plus the “blue” note (the flattened fifth).  
So the notes are:

| Scale degree | Note |
|--------------|------|
| 1 (root)     | A    |
| b3 (minor 3rd)| C   |
| 4 (perfect 4th)| D   |
| b5 (flattened 5th / blue note)| Eb |
| 5 (perfect 5th)| E   |
| b7 (minor 7th)| G   |
| 8 (octave)   | A    |

**Pattern in interval terms:**  
1 – b3 – 4 – b5 – 5 – b7 – 8  

(Or, in semitone steps: 0, 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, 12.)
